name: frameworks/hardhat
build: npm ci && cp .env.example .env && npx hardhat compile
solo_test: npm ci && cp .env.example .env && npx hardhat test

name: frameworks/hardhat-viem
build: npm ci && LOCAL_NODE_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:7546 LOCAL_NODE_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY= npx hardhat compile
solo_test: npm ci && LOCAL_NODE_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY=$ECDSA_ALIAS_PRIVATE_KEY npx hardhat test

name: frameworks/brownie
ci_note: tests need accounts loaded from an interactive brownie keystore

name: clients/go
solo_test: cp .env.sample .env && OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY=$ECDSA_PRIVATE_KEY go test -v ./...

name: apps/metamask-dapp
build: npm ci && echo '{}' > src/contracts/.bootstrapInfo.json && CI=false npm run build
solo_test: cp localDappCI.env .env && docker compose up --exit-code-from synpress

name: indexing/subgraph
build: npm ci && cp .env.example .env && npx hardhat compile && npm run graph-codegen && npm run graph-build
solo_test: npm ci && cp .env.example .env && npx hardhat compile && npx hardhat prepare && npm run graph-codegen && IPFS_PROFILE=test npm run graph-local -- --detach && sleep 20 && npm run create-local && npm run deploy-local -- --network local --version-label 0.0.1 && sleep 10 && npx hardhat test

name: indexing/erc-indexer
solo_test: npm ci && cp local.env .env && bash scripts/solo-port-forward.sh && HEDERA_NETWORK=local-node MIRROR_NODE_URL_WEB3=http://127.0.0.1:8545 npm run test:acceptance

name: interoperability/layer-zero
build: npm ci && HEDERA_PK=$DUMMY_PRIVATE_KEY BSC_PK=$DUMMY_PRIVATE_KEY npx hardhat compile
ci_note: tests need funded Hedera testnet + BSC testnet accounts

name: interoperability/crosschain-bridge
build: npm ci && HEDERA_PK=$DUMMY_PRIVATE_KEY SEPOLIA_PK=$DUMMY_PRIVATE_KEY HEDERA_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7546 SEPOLIA_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545 npx hardhat compile
ci_note: tests need funded Hedera testnet + Sepolia accounts

name: tokens/whbar

solo_test: npm ci && cp .env.example .env && ECDSA_HEX_PRIVATE_KEY=$ECDSA_PRIVATE_KEY NETWORK=local npx hardhat test test/solo/WHBAR.js
